facts.business: Kotyark Industries Limited is engaged in the bio-fuel business, specifically dealing with raw materials like Veg Ester and supplying to Oil Marketing Companies.

auditor.name: Mittal V. Kothari & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding seizure of four storage tanks containing raw material (Veg Ester) at Swaroopganj unit by authorities and related criminal proceedings against a director; inventory continues to be carried at value as management is confident of release and favourable outcome.

key_risks: Legal proceedings and seizure of raw material inventory by Bio-Fuel Authority, Government of Rajasthan
Dependence on renewal of registration with Bio-Fuel Authority
Concentration of transactions with subsidiary Kotyark Bio Specialities Limited
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with subsidiary Kotyark Bio Specialities Limited for aggregate value not exceeding ₹250 Crore during FY 2026-27, covering sale/purchase of goods, services, loans/advances including ICDs, and reimbursement of expenses.
